Patchset 11 separates out the already existing GPIO config sanity check into it's own callable function without altering the logic.

Next patchset will refactor names to reflect the new 'local' usages.

My hope is that doing it this way will make it easier for folks who don't know the logic here well to glance over the changes in parts and go "yeah, that makes enough sense"
The logic here has not been changed from the lines removed from 478 - 559, beyond key variables being passed in through a header for easier reuse now.

Patchset 10->11 extracts the pre-existing sanity checking logic for GPIO Presence pin into a re-usable function w/o further modification.

Patchset 11->12 refactors the variable names to reflect the now-local scope, and updates 'gpio status monitor' handling to use the new function, instead of relying on copy/pasted inline sanity checking code.

These two patches *did not* have CI tool formatting applied to them before commit to make human review a little simpler.

I'll likely put up another commit later with CI-tool suggested formatting once I've confirmed the CI tool is working for dbus-sensors (I was having a bit of trouble with it the other week...)
Is there a PDI patch somewhere?
